# devin_repository_indexing (Resource)

Enables indexing (code search and wiki) for a connected repository in an organization. The repository's default branch is always indexed. Destroying the resource turns indexing off and clears its configured branches. Creating it, or adding branches, starts indexing jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Index the default branch only.
resource "devin_repository_indexing" "api" {
  org_id          = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  repository_path = "acme/api"
}

# Index release branches as well as the default branch.
resource "devin_repository_indexing" "web" {
  org_id          = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  repository_path = "acme/web"
  branch_names    = ["release/2026.10", "release/2026.11"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID to index the repository in.
- `repository_path` (String) Repository path, e.g. owner/repo. The organization must have access to the repository.

### Optional

- `branch_names` (Set of String) Branches to index in addition to the default branch.

### Read-Only

- `branches` (Set of String) All branches configured for indexing, as reported by Devin. When branch_names is set, Devin also adds the default branch here.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Repository indexing is imported with the org ID followed by the repository path.
terraform import devin_repository_indexing.web org-e2a868a8a12a4c53809dea41fbf7ee99/acme/web
```
